content: Pedro niyaito Cornéliochica jiyoe tinunca
Tsanqueri israelita itonlanan Diosichi fiquica meráto quereilainue. Junni Crístochi mantá tanlabe uyan Jesucrístobe penenamin israelítalabe Judea tobi junca meralaquinue.
Junto weyan weyanla israelítala talasiri nenantsan joe tito, Pédrolaca pailainue. Junni Pedro Jerusalenca manjaca josa, yaca seitonque pato,
itsanlatinue: —¿Nuri niyaito israelita itonlachica jito yalabe ano pefiyun? latinue.
Junni Pedro yalachi fiquica merasi, yalabe beconan pato, tsarasi tuca pato itsantinue:
—La Jope pueblobi chuto Diosibe rocainamanyoe tinue. Junto lachi quirajanasa wa jali cuyan tsanni quiranca quirayoe tinue. Jamochi nechi junpalu puntabi tela jun patae tinue. Lachite patae tinue.
Junni ya jalibi quiranan, duque animali poe tinue. Jelenquiran animalila, quela, susu, pini, baro titiya poe tinue.
Junnasa mantimini itsanque fiqui mera jae. Lachi mumunca pato, Pedro tie. Cupade! In animalilaca toteto fide! tie tinue.
La mantimini itsantiyoe tinue: Te, fino miitoyoe. Miya Diosi, nu mirae. Lari numanan fitununcari fitumanyoe. Chiranlaca fitumanyoe tiyoe tinue.
Junnasa jamochi nechi itsanque fiqui manmerajae: Diosi ticatiya fintsan suwayoe tinari, nuri junca chiran tituna! tie tinue.
Junni peman ne jun tsan jun tsannan tilatiyoe. Junsi jalica jamochi manlaricae tinue.
Junni jali jamochi manlonasaleri, pemanca tsachila la chunun yabi falainue. Ya pemanca tsachilari Cesarea pueblobi nechi ereca jun jaca jominlanue laca neyabi.

Junni yala jalainasanan, Diosichi Tenca labe itsantie tinue: Natiya jeleratuto ya tsachilabe pejiniide! tie tinue. Junni in sotaca Jesucrístobe penenaminla labe pejica jominlae tinue. Chiquila layaito Cesaréaca jito, ya capitanchi yabi wilaiyoe tinue.

Junni yari chiquilabe cuenta quito yachi yabi anjelica wiruraminca quirayoe tie tinue. Anjeli yabe itsanque pae tie tinue: Jope puebloca tsachilaca ereto, junbi nechi Simón Pédroca tanjasa carideque mantanue tie tinue.
Pedro micarinun fiquica meralaquito, nunan nuchi yabi chuminlanan se lono podeilaichunae tie tie tinue.

Junni ya capitan pacaca tsanque manpolarito, Pedro itsantinue: —Lari ya capitanbe nasiri cuenta quiyoe tinue. Junnasaleri Diosichi Tenca patato yalachibi wie tinue. Chiquilachibi casale winun cuwenta, jun tsanquenan yalachibinan wie tinue.

Junca quirato, Miya Jesús paca jun fiquica mantenhiyoe tinue. Jesucristo chiquilabe itsantica jominue tinue: Mumunmin Juanbe penenaminlari pibiri mumunhilainue. Nula mantimini Diosichi Tencachi mumunhilaichunae. Yachi Tencaca erechunae tica jominue tinue nulachibi wisa.

¿Aman chiquila Jesucrístobe cayailainunbi, Diosi yachi Tencaca chiquilachibi tsanque ereco? tinue. Junni Diosichi Tenca jun tsachilachibinan jun tsanquenan patae tinue chiquilachibi cuwenta. Aman junca quirato, lari Diosichi contra natiya pano podeitiyoe tinue.

Junni Pedro tsantinaminca meráminla, natiya beco pano podeilaitunue. Junni Diosica duque seque pato itsantilatinue: —Junni Diosi israelita itonlacanan jutsa quinunca telaqueposa carito, casan tala tenca mancasa carinae tinue yape yalanan numatotiya Diosibe sonnato polelaisa.
Antioquíabi Jesucrístobe cayaito penenaminla

Aman junsi israelítala Estébanca totetobi, jerale Jesucrístobe penenaminlabe seiton ica jominlanue. Junni israelítalaca jelechi Jesucrístobe penenaminla ara cura jera sujica jominlanue. Fenecia toca, Chipre toca, Antioquía puebloca sujica jominlanue. Junchi sujito nenato, Diosichi fiquica micaridede nenaminlanue. Junni casale israelítalacasiri micarinaminlanue.

Tsan josanan weyan weyanla Antioquía pueblocanan jito, junbi israelita itonlacanan micarilaquinue. Ya micariminla Chipre tobi nechi, Cirene tobi nechi joto, israelita itonlabenan Miya Jesuca panilaquinue.
Junni yala micarilaquinasanan, Miya Diosinan sonba peayudainaminue yape antioquíalanan quereilaisa. Junni duque tsachila ya micaricaca quereito, Miya Jesucrístobe cayailainue.
Junni Jerusalenbi chumin Jesucrístobe penenaminlari layaito junca meralaquinue. Tsanque merasi, Bernabeca Antioquía puebloca erenue.

Bernaberi sen tsachi jominue. Diosichi Tencabe jera seque mantaito nenato, Diosica tsara quereimin jominue. Yari Antioquíaca jito, Diosi junbi seque quinanunca quirato, duque son tinue. Junsi piyanlelacanan payinue. Miya Jesuca telaquepotuto, sonba tenca cato nenalarana! tito payinue. Junni nantanancari duque tsachila Miya Jesube cayailainue.
Junsi Bernaberi Tarso puebloca jito, Sáuloca manneyanue. Junni Sáulobe mantulaito, Antioquíaca mantanjato,

man wata fecári Antioquíabi chuminlanue. Jesucrístochi tsachilabe pelayailaito, duque tsachilaca micarinaminlanue. Junni Antioquíabi chuminlari Jesucrístobe penenaminlaca cristianola timin jominlanue. Jun pueblobi casalele nechi Crístobe penenaminlaca ya mumun polaquinue.

Junnasa mantimini Diosichi mantate paminla jominlanue. Yala manca Agabo mumun jominue. Junni Jerusalenbi nechi Antioquíaca jato, Agábori, Diosichi tsachilachi quitsale wiruito, yalabe cuenta quinue. Diosichi Tencabe mantaca jun yalabe itsantinue: —Inale jerale tote chuminla ano itonan padeseilaichunae tinue. Junni inale Claudio miya josanan, jun tsanquenan ano itonan padeseino patilainue.

Junni Jesucrístobe penenaminla Agabo pacaca merasi, ayudaichun tenca calaquinue. Judea toca calaca erechun tenca calaquinue yape junbi chumin Jesucrístobe penenaminla, yalanan padeseilaitusa. Duque tanla duque cuwalaquinue; nasi tanla nasi cuwalaquinue.
Junni tsanque calaca layaquetobi, Bernabeca, Sáuloca erelaquinue yape Jesucrístochi tsachila tala mantá tanlachi cuwapolaquisa.
